title: Commerce SOW terms
content: S100 covers Commerce Analytics through 2026-10-31. Extension requires commercial approval. Alex Sample is a named resource. Monthly approved-hour cap is 320.

title: Retail onboarding checklist
content: Before starting client work, complete client access approval, laptop provision and compliance training. Morgan Demo coordinates client security approval.

title: Claims delivery handover
content: Claims Data Platform uses Databricks and PySpark. Handover must include pipeline runbooks, data quality exceptions, access owners and recovery procedures.

title: Insurance SOW renewal notes
content: S200 expires on 2026-10-20. S201 is draft and does not provide signed coverage. The delivery owner must coordinate extension approval.

title: Retail account briefing
content: Northstar Retail operates an offshore and onshore model. Critical resource transitions require a documented handover and client communication plan.
